contribution.title: Bucketed parallel core-cell connectivity
contribution.summary: Connect neighboring DBSCAN core cells by bucketing candidate work and merging discovered core-point connections with parallel union-find, reducing redundant distance tests and synchronization while preserving exact DBSCAN connectivity.
contribution.paper_location: Section 4.4 and Algorithm 3 (BCP-based core-cell connectivity, parallel union-find, and bucketing); Section 7 (our-exact-bucketing implementation)
contribution.metric: Exact DBSCAN correctness is a hard gate; the primary metric is paired repeated elapsed computation time at the fixed worker count.
